Name: Output
Description: where to write the bspzip file list. defaults to <map>_files.txt beside the bsp.

Name: SourceDirectory
Description: an extra loose content root to search, on top of the ones gameinfo.txt names.

Name: Strict
Description: exit with an error if any referenced asset could not be found.
Warning: a map referencing base-game content under an unusual name can trip this.

Name: NoVpk
Description: do not read the game's vpks; everything not found loose is reported missing.

Name: RenameNav
Description: list the navigation mesh as maps/embed.nav.

Name: RenameParticleManifest
Description: list the particle manifest as particles.txt.

Name: Report
Description: how much to print: summary, detailed, or json.

Name: Verbose
Description: print every asset as it resolves.
